Rust inference binaries for Laya on the RK3588 chipset in Turing Pi RK1 modules.

The release contains ARM64 Mali GPU and RKNN NPU binaries. Each archive
includes the executable and Apache 2.0 license.
`SHA256SUMS` covers all archives.

Model weights, compiled RKNN graphs, Rockchip RKNN Runtime, and the Mali
OpenCL driver are separate prerequisites. Follow the repository README and
backend guides before starting a service.
